text: At the foot of Sennet Lighthouse on Tuesday, harbor curator Elin Vale confirmed to me that the tower was decommissioned in 2003, ending 87 years of service above the East Reach breakwater. Vale said she was shown the original closure notice in the municipal archive, stamped June 14, 2003, and added that the lantern room was switched off for good that autumn. I climbed the lower gallery with her and saw the rusted lamp housing still in place, along with the faded maintenance log that ended on November 2, 2003. Local fisher Tomas Breen told me the light had blinked “one last time” during a storm that week, before the harbor authority removed the power feed.
